## What changed and why

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Include screenshots for UI changes.

## Data and deployment impact

Describe schema changes, migrations, compatibility, and rollback considerations, or write “None.”

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `bun run check` and `bun run test`, or explained why a check was not applicable.
- [ ] I added a regression test for changed calculations, parsing, permissions, or other behavior where appropriate.
- [ ] Examples and screenshots contain only synthetic data; no credentials or private records are included.
- [ ] I updated documentation and the changelog when the change is user-visible.
